console-empty-body: Register a URL and we will send it a signed POST when something happens on your account.
console-error-body: Check your connection and try again.
deliveries-none-body: Send a test event to see how your endpoint responds.
detail-delete-body: Delete {{url}} and its delivery log. This cannot be undone.
detail-disabled-hint: Endpoints switch off after repeated failed deliveries. Enabling it resets the failure count.
detail-error-body: It may have been deleted, or the connection dropped.
detail-overlap: The previous signing secret is still accepted until {{when}}.
detail-redelivered: Sent again as a new delivery.
detail-rotate-body: You get a new secret now. The current one keeps working for 24 hours, and every delivery carries both signatures until then.
detail-test-error: Could not send the test event.
form-intro: We send a signed HTTPS POST to this URL for each event you pick.
page-description: Each endpoint receives a signed POST for the events it subscribes to. Inspect deliveries, send a test event and rotate the signing secret without dropping events.
secret-overlap: The previous secret stays valid for 24 hours. Deliveries carry both signatures until then.
secret-warning: Copy this secret now. It is shown once and cannot be retrieved later.
detail-disabled-staff-hint: If RMH Studios staff disabled it to secure your account, its secret was replaced. Rotate the secret below to get a new one, then enable the endpoint.
